description: Change the store name, contact email, currency, locale, timezone, logo, brand color, tax (settings.tax.rate_bps: 1600 = 16%, mode inclusive|exclusive) and manual shipping (settings.shipping: flat_rate_amount, free_over_amount, pickup.enabled). Money is an integer in minor units: $199.90 MXN is 19990.

auto_email.description: Email buyers who left without paying, once.

required_consent.description: A checkbox the buyer must accept to pay, e.g. "Confirmo que soy mayor de 18 años". Stored with the order.

download_page_url.description: Store page for downloads, e.g. https://tienda.com/descargas/{token} (download-page component). Emails link there instead of straight to the file.

site_url.description: The storefront; default landing page after payment links.

dry_run.description: Validate and show what would happen without changing anything.

name: store_update_settings
title: Update store settings
